title: 鸿门宴，到底死了谁？
script: next-video/hongmen/script_v4.md, the 旁白 column: 22 lines, 362 字
about: text = the narration line exactly as in the script, punctuation included. It is what the captions are cut from and what the timing counts.

tts = the text that is sent to the speech engine, on every line that holds a word whose reading the owner's ear has to confirm. Same number of Chinese characters as text. Captions never use it. A line without tts sends text. Where a same-sound spelling is the safer bet it is already in (庆家 for 亲家, 樊快 for 樊哙, 刀组 for 刀俎); where the script's spelling is expected to read right (曹无伤) tts equals text and alt holds the fall-back spelling.
say = the reading that line needs. alt = a second spelling to send if the first take reads wrong.
quotes = a character's own words inside the line, in order (the lip-sync lines 5, 6, 8, 9, 17, 19). who = the speaker's key in PEOPLE (src/videos/hongmen/people.ts), name = the role.

hold_before = a silent beat inside the line: at = the words that follow the beat, s = its length in seconds. The line is recorded as two clips cut at this point; the join is written to the timing json as "cuts". Optional say_s = the seconds the words after the beat get in the placeholder timing, instead of characters / 5.4 (not set).
hold_after = the silence after the line in seconds, in place of the usual short gap.

shot_min_f = the picture of this line must be at least this many frames long, counted from the cut into it (frame 0 for line 1) to the cut into the next line (2 frames before that line's first word). If the words are shorter, the difference is silence before the next line.
cut_after = the picture cuts to another place before the next line: this line's last caption is taken off 2 frames before the next line's first word instead of staying up to it.
note = for the person who records and cuts the voice.
loop = the film loops: its last line and its first line are one sentence. It is recorded as ONE take (record) and cut after cut_after; the first half is line 22, the second half is line 1.

loop.record: 至于刘邦，他靠上厕所，躲过了一场暗杀。

lines.text: 他靠上厕所，躲过了一场暗杀。
lines.note: Recorded together with line 22 as ONE sentence 「至于刘邦，他靠上厕所，躲过了一场暗杀。」 and cut at the first comma: line 22 = 「至于刘邦，」, line 1 = the rest. The film loops from its last frame to its first, so the two halves must sound like one breath. Do not record line 1 on its own.

lines.text: 这顿饭叫鸿门宴。满屋刀剑，最后只死了一个人，还不在席上。
秦朝刚灭亡，刘邦抢先打下了都城。
可项羽强得多：四十万大军，对他十万。
刘邦手下有个军官向项羽告密：“刘邦想称王。”
项羽大怒：“明天就打他！”
当晚，项羽的叔叔跑来报信，刘邦当场和他约为亲家。
lines.tts: 当晚，项羽的叔叔跑来报信，刘邦当场和他约为庆家。
lines.say: 约为亲家 = yuē wéi qìng jia (亲 is qìng here, not qīn)
lines.alt: 当晚，项羽的叔叔跑来报信，刘邦当场和他约为亲家。

lines.text: 第二天一早，刘邦上门赔罪：“一定是有小人挑拨。”
项羽张口就说：“是你手下曹无伤说的。”
lines.tts: 项羽张口就说：“是你手下曹无伤说的。”
lines.alt: 项羽张口就说：“是你手下曹吴伤说的。”

lines.text: 项羽留刘邦喝酒。可项羽的谋士范增，认定刘邦必须死。
范增三次举起玉佩，催项羽动手，项羽没反应。
范增就叫人进来舞剑，想趁机刺死刘邦。
项羽的叔叔也下场舞剑，用身子挡着亲家。
lines.tts: 项羽的叔叔也下场舞剑，用身子挡着庆家。
lines.say: 亲家 = qìng jia, the same reading as in line 7
lines.alt: 项羽的叔叔也下场舞剑，用身子挡着亲家。

lines.text: 刘邦的保镖樊哙撞倒卫兵，冲了进来。
lines.tts: 刘邦的保镖樊快撞倒卫兵，冲了进来。
lines.say: 樊哙 = Fán Kuài (樊 2nd tone: 范增 is Fàn, 4th)
lines.alt: 刘邦的保镖樊哙撞倒卫兵，冲了进来。

lines.text: 项羽夸他是壮士，赏他一条猪腿。生的。
刘邦起身去上厕所，把樊哙也叫了出去。
lines.tts: 刘邦起身去上厕所，把樊快也叫了出去。
lines.alt: 刘邦起身去上厕所，把樊哙也叫了出去。

lines.text: 刘邦说还没告辞。樊哙说：“人为刀俎，我为鱼肉，告什么辞！”
lines.tts: 刘邦说还没告辞。樊快说：“人为刀组，我为鱼肉，告什么辞！”
lines.say: 樊哙 = Fán Kuài; 刀俎 = dāo zǔ; 人为 / 我为 = wéi (2nd tone)
lines.alt: 刘邦说还没告辞。樊哙说：“人为刀俎，我为鱼肉，告什么辞！”

quotes.name: 樊哙
quotes.text: 人为刀俎，我为鱼肉，告什么辞！

lines.text: 刘邦丢下车队，只骑一匹马，抄小路回了军营。
等刘邦到了军营，他的谋士才进去说：“他喝多了。”
刘邦回营第一件事：杀了曹无伤，那个告密的军官。
lines.tts: 刘邦回营第一件事：杀了曹无伤，那个告密的军官。
lines.say: 曹无伤 = Cáo Wúshāng, the same reading as in line 9
lines.alt: 刘邦回营第一件事：杀了曹吴伤，那个告密的军官。

lines.text: 而这个名字，是项羽自己说漏的。
至于刘邦，
lines.note: The first half of the loop sentence 「至于刘邦，他靠上厕所，躲过了一场暗杀。」: record that sentence as ONE take and cut it at the first comma. This clip is the words up to the comma; line 1 is the rest. The voice must stay up at the comma (the sentence goes on when the film loops), never fall as at a full stop.
